entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is absolute garbage. The pulse monitor is a joke. It's completely inaccurate. I want my money back.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the pulse monitor? Is it a technical fault you're seeing?
What did I just say? It's broken! It's a fault! This thing is garbage. Look, I don't have time to play 20 questions. I want a refund.

I understand your frustration. For technical faults, our standard process is to connect you with our tech support team. They can troubleshoot the issue, and if it's a confirmed hardware defect, they can authorize a replacement immediately.
No! I'm not talking to another person. I don't want a replacement, I just want money back in my account. I don't have time for this! This is ridiculous. Get me a manager.

I can certainly check on that, but I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Without troubleshooting, it's difficult for me to process this as a defect claim. Let me just pull up your order details and review our return policy.
You do that. And if you tell me I can't return this piece of junk, I'm going to light up every review site on the internet. You have no idea.

Okay, one moment please... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered to you 43 days ago. Let me check the policy... Yes, according to our knowledge base, all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. You're unfortunately outside that timeframe.
Finally! See? Was that so hard? You should have just done that from the start instead of trying to waste my time.

My apologies for the confusion. I can definitely process this return for a full refund for you now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just place the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Fine. When do I get my money?

Once the return is received at our warehouse, which usually takes 3-5 business days, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 24-48 hours. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Just make sure it happens.
It certainly will. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
